text:
Marta: quick design review — a few small nits on the Encryption keys panel I noticed while prepping the compliance demo
Liam: yep saw that earlier, what stood out?
Marta: label inconsistency: panel shows 'Owner' but audit log and policies use 'Key ownership' / 'key_source'. feels confusing for customers
Sheryl: from an eng perspective shorter is easier, but a11y team flagged 'Owner' as ambiguous for screen readers
Alex: security wants the options explicit: 'Customer-managed' vs 'Redwood-managed' rather than abbreviations like 'KMS' or 'System'
Keisha: big accessibility nit: after you pick 'Customer-managed' focus jumps to the region dropdown — primary CTA (Save) is after that which breaks expected tab order
Marta: proposal in Figma: change heading to 'Key managed by' and radio labels to: 'Customer‑managed (KMS)' and 'Redwood‑managed (system)'. add a short helper text under the radios
Liam: I like 'Key managed by' but can we avoid parentheses if they clutter? maybe move the short qualifier into helper text
Alex: security prefers the qualifier inline so it's explicit in the UI (customers check quickly during audits)
Keisha: backend note — display label can differ from stored field. we can keep backend field 'key_source' and map to friendly label 'Key management' in UX
Sheryl: confirmed — no backend break, we'll map on the API layer
a11y-bot: Accessibility checks: 1) radio group needs aria-describedby pointing to helper text; 2) ensure focus order: radio group -> primary action -> secondary; 3) contrast: the 'managed' badge color fails WCAG AA on gray background
Marta: updated mock: moved primary button directly after radios, helper text reads: 'Customer-managed keys require KMS access and explicit rotation.' kept qualifier inline for audit clarity
Liam: tiny copy tweak for audit log filter: change label from 'key_source' to 'Key management' and tooltip text to 'Filter by who manages the encryption key'
Alex: +1, also change tooltip on the details panel to 'Shows whether the key is managed by you or Redwood' (more explicit for auditors)
Keisha: region dropdown: product asked to surface 'Auto (closest)' at top if customer hasn't pinned a region. can we add that and make screen reader announce current selection: 'Select deployment region, current: Auto (closest)'
Marta: will add Auto option to top and update SR label. also will update copy and focus order tonight and post new mock
Sheryl: I'll add an e2e that asserts focus order and the radio aria-describedby exists
Alex: and I'll add a short retention to the audit entry for key changes — tooltip text should say 'Records changes to key management and access' instead of 'Key events'
Marta: thanks all — will push updated figma link once done and tag everyone. :thumbsup:
Liam: great, thanks — ping if anything blocks shipping this week
Keisha: noted, will include in the compliance checklist for the release
Marta: done for now, will follow up with the new mock.
